goal: Validate source-bound comparison profiles and unchanged semantic admission policy on two existing reviewed operation selections.

scope.selection_basis: Two documented tagmentation operations in different substrate contexts; development cases, not held-out scientific validation.

predeclared_checks: Exact selected States/Operations appear in native profile prompt
Profile integrity and selected-boundary coverage pass
Unknown and unassessed values are not retrieval facts
Compiler and fresh reviewer can read scoped profiles and original source passages
Same semantic retrieval backend/settings are required throughout planning and fresh admission
Any admitted membership passes fresh source and utility review; zero admissions are valid
Every native prompt, command, event stream, result, usage and artifact hash is preserved
not_established: No component interchangeability or experimental validation
No optimal retrieval model or shortlist size
No all-atlas recall or zero hallucination claim
stop_policy: Bounded model attempts; no automatic refusal retry; failures preserved, not converted into successful matching.
